# Image acceptance fixtures

`hopper.jpg` is the 128×128 photographic fixture from the Pillow project:
https://github.com/python-pillow/Pillow/blob/main/Tests/images/hopper.jpg

It is used only as a real JPEG input for the installed `kitten icat` tool.
The executable does not contain this file. Pillow's upstream licensing is
https://github.com/python-pillow/Pillow/blob/main/LICENSE .

The transparent PNG and exact RGBA color patches are generated by
`tests/graphics_smoke.py`; these fixtures test pixel values independently of
photographic appearance. Parser-specific PNG fixtures and mutation tests live
under `crates/zgraphics/tests/data` and `crates/zgraphics/src/tests.rs`.
